title: MASTERS ATTP 2024: the first edition
excerpt: MASTERS ATTP-2024 – a remarkable edition this year, on a special scale.
body_html:
MASTERS ATTP-2024 — a remarkable edition this year, on a special scale and with extraordinary energy, marking an important historic moment for all of us!

The images from the tournament tell the story of an unprecedented experience, full of captivating displays by top players, opportunities, analysis and conclusions that brought to the fore the perspectives and innovative ideas needed to develop table tennis in the Republic of Moldova.

The best and most honest table tennis players in Moldova, who took part in the tournament, were a source of inspiration for the Organisers, and every stage of the Event was a step towards our shared goal — a more active, more united and healthier community.

We feel motivated and excited about what the future holds!

Thank you to everyone who made this Event possible! Together we are a powerful force for the growth of table tennis in Moldova!

Thank you to SETKA-Pro (Moldova) and TOP CUP Academy for their cooperation and substantial support!

We’re glad to have you with us!
